question: What office is exercised in the tapas world and what lies above it?
premises: In the tapas world the lords of creatures born from Brahma exercise their office.
Above the tapas world lies the abode of Brahma, called Satya.
The Satya world is sixteen crores above the tapas world.
inference: The tapas world is an administrative realm of Brahma-born progenitors, leading upward to Brahma's own Satya world.
plain_english: There the lords of creatures born from Brahma hold their office. Above the Tapas world, sixteen crores away, is Satya, the abode of Brahma.
